opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations (CIOs), exempt and excepted charities; must have at least one year of audited or examined accounts or a Charity Commission annual return.
opportunities.summary: Open to applications year‑round for operating/core cost, capital project, or project‑specific activity grants up to £100,000. No submission deadlines.

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations (CIOs), exempt and excepted charities; must have annual income over £1 million for core‑cost grants or total project/capital cost of at least £1 million for capital or project grants; must have at least one year of audited or examined accounts or a Charity Commission annual return.
opportunities.summary: Major grants for organisations with sufficient income or project size, covering operating/core costs, capital projects or specific activity projects. Applications accepted year‑round with no fixed deadline; expressions of interest reviewed on a rolling basis.
